variant: full: Qwen2.5 and Mistral v0.1 -> v0.2 from their _xsfull re-runs (D-206, D-212)
rule: final-layer paired refusal ratio < 1 with band95 upper < 1 (selected C, item level); cluster level and C=1 beside; 'rose_at_an_earlier_layer' = some earlier layer with band95 lower > 1
band_note: band95: 2.5-97.5% over the 1000 re-partitions of the Aegis negatives that set the thresholds (D-156; cluster level D-164); XSTest is fixed (D-167), so the band does not cover XSTest item sampling
last_layer_note: the last grid layer is each model's last hidden state (extract_hidden stores hidden_states[li]); for these models that entry follows the final norm, so it is the only post-norm layer in the grid
floor_note: a ratio with floored draws is an 'at most' value (D-163 (2), D-208)
